sentences.en: We need to exchange some Australian dollars before we travel to Sydney.
sentences.zh: 我们需要去兑换一些澳元，准备去悉尼旅行。

sentences.en: The price is listed in Australian dollars, so make sure you understand the exchange rate.
sentences.zh: 价格是以澳元列出的，所以要确保你能理解汇率。

sentences.en: He saved up a lot of Australian dollars during his time working as an expatriate in Australia.
sentences.zh: 他在澳大利亚做外派工人的时候攒了一大笔澳元。
